reason: As someone who has quit three services, B answers my real worries: no contract, skip or cancel any time, swap meals for 6 other choices, order deadline and delivery area, and a named dietitian who admits the 14 results were self-selected. A is honest too but leaves out the cancel and swap terms I need before paying $59, and its 'real food you'll want to eat' line sounds like the promises I've heard before.
